- **Adults aged 50 years and older** should get the shingles vaccine.

- The preferred vaccine is **Shingrix** (a recombinant vaccine), which is more effective than the older Zostavax (live vaccine).

- **Shingrix is publicly funded (free) for:**

|-------------------|---------------|-----------------------|
| 50–64 years       | Recommended   | No                    |
| 65–70 years       | Recommended   | Yes                   |
| 71+ years         | Recommended   | No                    |

### Why Get the Vaccine?
- Shingles (herpes zoster) is caused by reactivation of the chickenpox virus and can cause painful rash and complications.
- The risk increases with age.

- [Public Health Agency of Canada – Shingles Vaccines](https://www.canada.ca/en/public-health/services/diseases/shingles/herpes-zoster-vaccine.html)
